import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

p = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
old = Path('<SOURCE_CONTROLLER_SCRATCH>')
out = p / 'native'
out.mkdir()
expected = json.loads((p / 'inputs.json').read_text())['frozen_sha256']


def verify():
    actual = {name: hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in expected}
    assert actual == expected, {name: (expected[name], actual[name]) for name in expected if actual[name] != expected[name]}
    return actual


def run(label, category, argv, cwd):
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (out / (label + '.stdout')).open('wb') as stdout, (out / (label + '.stderr')).open('wb') as stderr:
        result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
    record = dict(stage=label, category=category, argv=argv, cwd=str(cwd), exit_code=result.returncode, seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
    with (out / 'phases.jsonl').open('a') as log:
        log.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)


(out / 'inputs-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(verify(), indent=2) + '\n')
try:
    cli = str(old / 'frozen/whitefootc')
    run('clang-version', 'identity', ['/usr/bin/clang', '--version'], p)
    assert (out / 'clang-version.stdout').read_bytes() == (old / 'screen/clang-version.log').read_bytes()

        run(arm + '-emission', 'source-emission', [cli, '--graph', 'modules.wfg', '--entry', 'main', '--emit-llvm', '-o', str(out / (arm + '.raw.ll'))], cwd)
        raw = (out / (arm + '.raw.ll')).read_text()
        assert raw.count('@main(') == 1, (arm, 'main-symbol count')
        timed = out / (arm + '-timed.ll')
        timed.write_text(raw.replace('@main(', '@wf_fixture_main('))
        base = ['/usr/bin/clang', '-O3', '-Wno-override-module', '-x', 'ir']
        run(arm + '-optimized-ir', 'native-emission', base + ['-S', '-emit-llvm', str(timed), '-o', str(out / (arm + '.opt.ll'))], p)
        run(arm + '-assembly', 'native-emission', base + ['-S', str(timed), '-o', str(out / (arm + '.s'))], p)
        run(arm + '-object', 'native-compilation', base + ['-c', str(timed), '-o', str(out / (arm + '.o'))], p)
        run(arm + '-symbols', 'native-inventory', ['/usr/bin/nm', '-n', '-m', str(out / (arm + '.o'))], p)
        run(arm + '-sections', 'native-inventory', ['/usr/bin/otool', '-l', str(out / (arm + '.o'))], p)
    (out / 'construction-complete.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(all_direct_commands_exit_zero=True, source_carrier_qualification='qualified retained baseline reused; see inputs.json', native_selection='pending inspection', linked=False, executed=False, timed=False), indent=2) + '\n')
finally:
    (out / 'inputs-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(verify(), indent=2) + '\n')
    artifacts = {str(path.relative_to(p)): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(out.iterdir()) if path.is_file()}
    (out / 'artifacts.json').write_text(json.dumps(artifacts, indent=2) + '\n')

"""One-shot authorized Vector branch-first swap-remove linking/correctness; no timing.

Scratch orchestration and independent artifact reading only. Retire with this
experiment after useful reproducible evidence is retained in its existing home.
"""
import ast
import csv
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import time
import traceback

P = Path('<SWAP_SCRATCH>/branch-first')
OUT = P / 'correctness'
OLD = Path('<SOURCE_CONTROLLER_SCRATCH>')
FAMILY = Path('<ACTUAL_ABLATION_SCRATCH>/research/experiments/container-representation/vector-library')
CONTROL = FAMILY / '.build/actual-ablation/terminal/ecosystem'
READER = FAMILY / '.build/constructor-save-edge/run.py'
PHASES = []
EXPECTED = json.loads((OUT / 'inputs.json').read_text())
LINKS = json.loads((OUT / 'link-commands.json').read_text())


def sha_bytes(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def sha(path):
    return sha_bytes(Path(path).read_bytes())


def require(ok, reason):
    if not ok:
        raise AssertionError(reason)


def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


for name in ['inputs.json', 'link-commands.json', 'PLAN.md', 'ecosystem.py']:
    EXPECTED[str(OUT / name)] = sha(OUT / name)


def verify():
    actual = {name: sha(name) for name in EXPECTED}
    require(actual == EXPECTED, {name: [EXPECTED[name], actual[name]] for name in EXPECTED if actual[name] != EXPECTED[name]})
    return actual


def run(directory, label, category, argv, status=0):
    stdout, stderr = directory / (label + '.stdout'), directory / (label + '.stderr')
    require(not stdout.exists() and not stderr.exists(), 'refuse repeated stage ' + label)
    start = time.monotonic()
    print('START', label, flush=True)
    with stdout.open('wb') as out, stderr.open('wb') as err:
        result = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], cwd=OUT, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    record = dict(stage=label, category=category, argv=[str(x) for x in argv], cwd=str(OUT),
                  exit_code=result.returncode, expected_exit_code=status, seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                  stdout=str(stdout), stderr=str(stderr))
    PHASES.append(record)
    with (directory / 'phases.jsonl').open('a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
    print('END', label, result.returncode, record['seconds'], flush=True)
    require(result.returncode == status, record)
    return stdout.read_bytes(), stderr.read_bytes()


def account_ir(raw):
    require(raw.count('@main(') == 1, 'exactly one main rename')
    text = raw.replace('@main(', '@wf_fixture_main(').replace('@malloc(', '@wf_cost_allocate(').replace('@free(', '@wf_cost_release(')
    declaration = 'declare ptr @wf_cost_allocate(i64)'
    require(text.splitlines().count(declaration) == 1, 'exact allocation declaration')
    return text.replace(declaration, 'declare noalias nonnull ptr @wf_cost_allocate(i64)')


# Reuse just the existing read-only Mach-O parser, without running its old trial.
tree = ast.parse(READER.read_text())
reader_node = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == 'unpack_macho']
require(len(reader_node) == 1, 'one existing Mach-O reader')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=reader_node, type_ignores=[]), str(READER), 'exec'))


def bytes_at(macho, data, address, size):
    section = next(s for s in macho['sections'] if s['address'] <= address and address+size <= s['address']+s['size'])
    offset = section['offset'] + address-section['address']
    return data[offset:offset+size]


def sign(value, bits):
    return value-(1 << bits) if value & (1 << (bits-1)) else value


def linked_inspection(obj_path, image_path):
    obj, a = unpack_macho(obj_path)
    image, b = unpack_macho(image_path)
    text = next(s for s in obj['sections'] if s['name'] == '__TEXT,__text')
    section_index = obj['sections'].index(text) + 1
    functions = sorted((s for s in obj['symbols'] if s['section'] == section_index and s['name'].startswith(('_wf', 'l_wf'))), key=lambda s: s['value'])
    linked = {s['name']: s for s in image['symbols'] if s['section'] and s['type'] & 0x0e == 0x0e}
    addresses = {s['name']: linked[s['name']]['value'] for s in functions if s['name'] in linked}
    stripped = {}
    for sym in functions:
        if sym['name'] not in addresses:
            require(sym['name'].startswith('l_wf'), 'unexpected stripped global ' + sym['name'])
            anchor = next(s for s in functions if s['value'] > sym['value'] and s['name'] in addresses)
            addresses[sym['name']] = addresses[anchor['name']] - (anchor['value']-sym['value'])
            stripped[sym['name']] = addresses[sym['name']]
    relocs = {r['address']: r for r in obj['relocations']['__TEXT,__text']}
    records, branch_checks, literal_checks = {}, [], []
    for index, sym in enumerate(functions):
        name, start = sym['name'], sym['value']
        end = functions[index+1]['value'] if index+1 < len(functions) else text['address']+text['size']
        if name == '_wf__floor_run':
            require(sym['descriptor'] & 0x80 and linked[name]['descriptor'] & 0x80 == 0, 'expected weak-to-strong floor resolution')
            continue
        linked_start = addresses[name]
        body_a = bytes_at(obj, a, start, end-start)
        body_b = bytes_at(image, b, linked_start, end-start)
        relocated = []
        for offset in range(0, end-start, 4):
            before, after = struct.unpack_from('<I', body_a, offset)[0], struct.unpack_from('<I', body_b, offset)[0]
            relocation = relocs.get(start-text['address']+offset)
            if relocation is None:
                require(before == after, (name, offset, 'unrelocated instruction changed'))
                continue
            relocated.append(offset)
            kind, target = relocation['type'], relocation['target']
            require(kind in (2, 3, 4) and isinstance(target, dict), ('unexpected relocation', relocation))
            mask = {2: 0xfc000000, 3: 0x9f00001f, 4: 0xffc003ff}[kind]
            require(before & mask == after & mask, (name, offset, 'relocation changed opcode/operands'))
            target_name = target['name']
            if kind == 2 and (target_name in addresses or target_name in linked):
                wanted = addresses[target_name] if target_name in addresses else linked[target_name]['value']
                actual = linked_start+offset+(sign(after & 0x3ffffff, 26) << 2)
                require(actual == wanted, (name, offset, 'branch target differs', actual, wanted))
                branch_checks.append(dict(function=name, offset=offset, target=target_name, address=actual))
            if kind == 3 and target_name.startswith('lCPI'):
                following = relocs.get(start-text['address']+offset+4)
                require(following and following['type'] == 4 and following['target'] == target, 'literal relocation pair')
                low = struct.unpack_from('<I', body_b, offset+4)[0]
                require(low & 0xffc00000 == 0x3dc00000, 'expected literal Q load')
                page = ((linked_start+offset) & ~4095) + (sign(((after >> 29) & 3) | (((after >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2), 21) << 12)
                address = page + ((low >> 10) & 0xfff)*16
                literal = bytes_at(obj, a, target['value'], 16)
                require(literal == bytes_at(image, b, address, 16), 'relocated literal changed')
                literal_checks.append(dict(function=name, offset=offset, target=target_name, linked_address=address, sha256=sha_bytes(literal)))
        records[name] = dict(object_start=start, linked_start=linked_start, instructions=(end-start)//4,
                             relocated_instruction_offsets=relocated, unrelocated_instructions_identical=True)
    floor_path = FAMILY / '.build/actual-ablation/terminal/native/wf_floor.o'
    floor, floor_bytes = unpack_macho(floor_path)
    floor_symbols = sorted((s for s in floor['symbols'] if s['section'] == 1 and s['name'].startswith('_wf')), key=lambda s:s['value'])
    floor_sym = next(s for s in floor_symbols if s['name'] == '_wf__floor_run')
    floor_end = next(s['value'] for s in floor_symbols if s['value'] > floor_sym['value'])
    floor_start = floor_sym['value']
    floor_address = linked['_wf__floor_run']['value']
    floor_a = bytes_at(floor, floor_bytes, floor_start, floor_end-floor_start)
    floor_b = bytes_at(image, b, floor_address, floor_end-floor_start)
    floor_relocs = {r['address']:r for r in floor['relocations']['__TEXT,__text']}
    for offset in range(0, floor_end-floor_start, 4):
        before, after = struct.unpack_from('<I', floor_a, offset)[0], struct.unpack_from('<I', floor_b, offset)[0]
        relocation = floor_relocs.get(floor_start+offset)
        if relocation is None:
            require(before == after, ('strong floor unrelocated instruction', offset))
        else:
            mask = {2: 0xfc000000, 3: 0x9f00001f, 4: 0xffc003ff, 5: 0x9f00001f, 6: 0xffc003ff}[relocation['type']]
            require(before & mask == after & mask, ('strong floor relocation opcode', offset))
            target = relocation['target']['name']
            if relocation['type'] == 2 and target in linked:
                actual = floor_address+offset+(sign(after & 0x3ffffff, 26) << 2)
                require(actual == linked[target]['value'], ('strong floor branch', offset, target))
    return dict(object_sha256=obj['file_sha256'], image_sha256=image['file_sha256'], file_size=image['file_size'],
                sections=image['sections'], symbols=image['symbols'], functions=records, stripped_local_addresses=stripped,
                branch_checks=branch_checks, literal_checks=literal_checks, strong_floor_sha256=sha(floor_path),
                strong_floor_unrelocated_instructions_identical=True)


def main():
    construction, check, candidate = OUT / 'construction', OUT / 'check', OUT / 'candidate'
    for path in (construction, check, candidate):
        path.mkdir()
    save(construction / 'inputs-before.json', verify())
    raw = (P / 'native/candidate.raw.ll').read_text()
    require(raw.replace('@main(', '@wf_fixture_main(') == (P / 'native/candidate-timed.ll').read_text(), 'timed IR differs beyond main')
    require(account_ir((OLD / 'control/vector-library.raw.ll').read_text()) == (CONTROL / 'whitefoot-account.ll').read_text(), 'baseline account transform differs')
    require(not re.search(r'@wf_(cost_allocate|cost_release|ecosystem_note_)', raw), 'observer in timed IR')
    account = candidate / 'whitefoot-account.ll'
    account.write_text(account_ir(raw))
    run(construction, 'candidate-account-object', 'native-compilation', ['/usr/bin/clang', '-O3', '-Wno-override-module', '-x', 'ir', '-c', account, '-o', candidate / 'whitefoot-account.o'])
    for mode in ('timed', 'account'):
        run(construction, 'candidate-'+mode+'-link', 'native-link', LINKS[mode]['command'])
    linked = {}
    images = {}
    for arm, directory in [('control', CONTROL), ('candidate', candidate)]:
        for mode in ('timed', 'account'):
            label = arm+'-'+mode
            image = directory / ('vector-costs-'+mode)
            images[label] = str(image)
            for kind, argv in [('sections', ['/usr/bin/otool', '-l']), ('symbols', ['/usr/bin/nm', '-n', '-m']), ('disassembly', ['/usr/bin/otool', '-tvV'])]:
                run(construction, label+'-'+kind, 'native-inventory', argv+[image])
            if mode == 'timed':
                require(not re.search(r'wf_(cost_allocate|cost_release|ecosystem_note_)', (construction / (label+'-symbols.stdout')).read_text()), 'observer in timed image')
            obj = CONTROL / ('whitefoot-'+mode+'.o') if arm == 'control' else (P / 'native/candidate.o' if mode == 'timed' else candidate / 'whitefoot-account.o')
            linked[label] = linked_inspection(obj, image)
    save(OUT / 'linked-package.json', dict(reader_path=str(READER), reader_sha256=sha(READER), arms=linked))
    image_hashes = {name: sha(path) for name, path in images.items()}
    save(construction / 'images.json', {name: dict(path=path, sha256=image_hashes[name]) for name,path in images.items()})
    save(construction / 'inputs-after.json', verify())
    save(check / 'inputs-before.json', verify())
    positive = b'vector ecosystem: 1260 configurations, 8820 executions passed\n'
    checksum = b'vector library costs: independent logical-order checksum\n'
    cleanup = b'vector library costs: complete cleanup\n'
    for arm in ('control', 'candidate'):
        for mode in ('timed', 'account'):
            out, err = run(check, arm+'-'+mode+'-check', 'positive-check', [images[arm+'-'+mode], 'check'])
            require(out == positive and err == b'', 'complete positive matrix output')
        for mode in ('timed', 'account'):
            out, err = run(check, arm+'-'+mode+'-fail-checksum', 'negative-control', [images[arm+'-'+mode], 'fail-checksum'], 1)
            require(out == b'' and err == checksum, 'checksum observer fault output')
        out, err = run(check, arm+'-account', 'instrumented-ledger', [images[arm+'-account'], 'account'])
        require(err == b'' and out == (CONTROL / 'accounting.csv').read_bytes(), 'exact frozen accounting ledger')
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(out.decode().splitlines()))
        keys = [(r['element_bytes'], r['path'], r['count'], r['variant']) for r in rows]
        wanted = set(itertools.product(('8', '256'), ('reserved', 'growth', 'reuse', 'suffix-0', 'suffix-1', 'suffix-2', 'suffix-3'), ('16', '256', '4096'), ('whitefoot', 'reverse-c', 'direct-c', 'swap-take-c', 'take-swap-c', 'rust-vec', 'cpp-std-vector')))
        require(len(keys) == len(set(keys)) == 294 and set(keys) == wanted, 'complete unique accounting product')
        out, err = run(check, arm+'-fail-cleanup', 'negative-control', [images[arm+'-account'], 'fail-cleanup'], 1)
        require(out == b'' and err == cleanup, 'cleanup observer fault output')
    require((check / 'control-account.stdout').read_bytes() == (check / 'candidate-account.stdout').read_bytes(), 'paired ledger equality')
    require(image_hashes == {name: sha(path) for name,path in images.items()}, 'image mutation during execution')
    save(check / 'inputs-after.json', verify())
    save(OUT / 'ecosystem-result.json', dict(status='all-four-images-and-faults-pass', image_checks=4, configurations_per_image=1260,
          executions_per_image=8820, harness_commands=12, checksum_faults=4, cleanup_faults=2, account_rows_per_arm=294,
          instrumented_ledger_sha256=sha(check / 'candidate-account.stdout'), all_frozen_inputs_unchanged=True,
          image_hashes=image_hashes, timing_executed=False,
          seconds_by_category={kind:sum(p['seconds'] for p in PHASES if p['category']==kind) for kind in sorted({p['category'] for p in PHASES})}))


try:
    main()
except Exception:
    (OUT / 'failure.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc())
    raise
finally:
    save(OUT / 'inputs-after.json', verify())
    save(OUT / 'ecosystem-artifacts.json', {str(p.relative_to(OUT)):sha(p) for p in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name not in ('ecosystem-artifacts.json', 'guard.stdout', 'guard.stderr')})

"""One-shot frozen-CLI fixture checks; retire with this private experiment."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CLI = Path('<SOURCE_CONTROLLER_SCRATCH>/frozen/whitefootc')
SNAPSHOT = Path('<SOURCE_CONTROLLER_SCRATCH>/snapshot')
OBSERVER = SNAPSHOT / 'tests/programs/containers/container-allocation-observer.c'
BACKEND = SNAPSHOT / 'compiler/src/backend'
EXPECTED = json.loads((P / 'inputs.json').read_text())
LINKS = json.loads((P / 'link-commands.json').read_text())
RUNTIME = [Path(p) for p in LINKS['timed']['unchanged_inputs'] if '/native/' in p]
assert len(RUNTIME) == 12
PHASES = []


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def verify():
    actual = {path: sha(path) for path in EXPECTED}
    assert actual == EXPECTED, {p: (EXPECTED[p], actual[p]) for p in EXPECTED if actual[p] != EXPECTED[p]}
    return actual


def save(path, data):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')


def run(label, kind, argv, cwd=P, status=0, workers=None):
    directory = P / 'fixture-logs'
    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    stdout, stderr = directory / (label + '.stdout'), directory / (label + '.stderr')
    assert not stdout.exists() and not stderr.exists(), label
    env = os.environ.copy()
    if workers is not None:
        env['WF_WORKERS'] = str(workers)
    start = time.monotonic()
    print('START', label, flush=True)
    with stdout.open('wb') as out, stderr.open('wb') as err:
        result = subprocess.run([str(x) for x in argv], cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    record = dict(stage=label, category=kind, argv=[str(x) for x in argv], cwd=str(cwd), workers=workers,
                  exit_code=result.returncode, expected_exit_code=status, seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                  stdout=str(stdout), stderr=str(stderr))
    PHASES.append(record)
    with (directory / 'phases.jsonl').open('a') as log:
        log.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
    print('END', label, result.returncode, record['seconds'], flush=True)
    assert result.returncode == status, record
    return stdout.read_bytes(), stderr.read_bytes()


def preflight():
    for arm in ['baseline', 'candidate']:
        out, err = run(arm+'-source-check', 'source-check', [CLI, '--graph', 'modules.wfg', '--check'], P/'fixtures'/arm)
        assert out == b'' and err == b'', (out, err)
        out, err = run(arm+'-empty-domain', 'source-negative', [CLI, '--graph', 'modules.wfg', '--check'], P/'negative'/arm, 1)
        assert b'FN-8' in out+err and b'Unsupported' not in out+err, (out, err)
    save(P/'preflight-result.json', dict(all_direct_statuses_expected=True, positive_graphs=2, empty_domain_rejections=2))


def build_one(arm, mode, entry):
    name = '-'.join([arm, mode, entry])
    directory = P/'fixture-images'
    raw = directory/(name+'.ll')
    flags = ['--par'] if mode == 'parallel' else []
    run(name+'-emit', 'source-emission', [CLI, '--graph', 'modules.wfg', '--entry', entry, '--emit-llvm', *flags, '-o', raw], P/'fixtures'/arm)
    text = raw.read_text()
    assert text.count('@main(') == 1 and '@malloc(' in text and '@free(' in text
    observed = directory/(name+'-observed.ll')
    observed.write_text(text.replace('@main(', '@wf_fixture_main(').replace('@malloc(', '@wf_observe_allocate(').replace('@free(', '@wf_observe_release('))
    images = {}
    for suffix, llvm in [('', raw), ('-observed', observed)]:
        obj, image = directory/(name+suffix+'.o'), directory/(name+suffix)
        run(name+suffix+'-object', 'native-compilation', ['/usr/bin/clang', '-O2', '-Wno-override-module', '-x', 'ir', '-c', llvm, '-o', obj])
        extra = [directory/'observer.o'] if suffix else []
        run(name+suffix+'-link', 'native-link', ['/usr/bin/clang', '-O2', obj, *extra, *RUNTIME, '-pthread', '-lm', '-o', image])
        images['observed' if suffix else 'ordinary'] = str(image)
    return images


def execute():
    directory = P/'fixture-images'
    directory.mkdir()
    run('observer-object', 'native-compilation', ['/usr/bin/clang', '-O2', '-std=c11', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-I'+str(BACKEND), '-I'+str(BACKEND/'completion'), '-c', OBSERVER, '-o', directory/'observer.o'])
    images = {}
    for arm in ['baseline', 'candidate']:
        for mode in ['sequential', 'parallel']:
            for entry in ['ordinary', 'focused']:
                images['-'.join([arm, mode, entry])] = build_one(arm, mode, entry)
    for entry in ['wrong_return', 'wrong_replacement', 'wrong_order']:
        images['candidate-parallel-'+entry] = build_one('candidate', 'parallel', entry)
    image_hashes = {name: {kind: dict(path=path, sha256=sha(path)) for kind, path in pair.items()} for name, pair in images.items()}
    save(P/'fixture-images.json', image_hashes)
    for name, pair in images.items():
